html:
Given 1 <= k <= len(values), return the k-th smallest integer counting duplicates. Use a heap of at most k elements.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      8,
      2,
      2,
      5
    ],
    3
  ],
  "expected": 5
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      7
    ],
    1
  ],
  "expected": 7
}
Hint

A size-k max-heap retains the k smallest values seen.

Complexity: O(n log(k+1)) time, O(k) space
